card.name: Partway through condition names in warnings
card.fires_on: Mostly the middle of 'phenylketonuria' or 'phenylketonurics' (the 'on' piece), and the middle of other condition words like hypertension or perforation. Also 'infection(s)' after 'active', 'localized' or 'periocular' in warnings.

modes.label: Phenylketonuria
modes.description: The 'on' piece inside phenylketonuria or phenylketonurics in warning headings and notes.

modes.label: Infection after a qualifier
modes.description: The word infection(s) after an adjective such as active, opportunistic, localized or periocular.
modes.example: Avoid use of OLUMIANT in patients with active, serious or opportunistic<< infection>>, including localized infections.

modes.label: Other condition words
modes.description: Middle of other long condition terms in section headings.

card.plain: It fires inside the word phenylketonuria and on infection in warnings about who should not take a drug.
